order: Apply the findings from an independent holistic review to the resource-tracking substrate and its round-three staleness window, and commit the resulting verdict record. Strike the previous seven-day stale ceiling entirely and replace it with a 48-hour ceiling, since a week-old reading no longer describes a pool state that exists; leave the 24-hour fresh window as it stands. Carry the staleness disclosure onto the published state object itself — not just the human report — so a snapshot consumer or dispatcher sees it too; the disclosure adds new fields and changes nothing else, and a stale reading can never arm or satisfy a confirmation gate, only a fresh one may. Leave the router's own routing fields computed as they were, and do not touch the router file itself. Ledger the outstanding exercise debt explicitly, extend the test suite to cover the new stale-window boundary, and record the review's verdict verbatim alongside the affected band records.
claims: The seven-day stale ceiling was struck and replaced with a 48-hour ceiling, while the 24-hour fresh window stayed unchanged; staleness now rides on the published state object itself (stale, ageMs), additive only, and a stale reading can never arm a confirmation gate. The router file was not touched, and its routing-relevant fields are computed exactly as before. `node tests/quartermaster.test.js` reports 191 checks, up from 187.
